capabilities: chat with an AI assistant in the right sidebar
persist a profile, memory cards, idea memos and conversation evidence as Markdown in .deepseek/
search notes and all memory layers together with note_recall
review, correct or archive memory cards in a memory panel
automatically find, configure and run the local dsh service
extras: Prototype at version 0.8.3; the author says understanding-building features (knowing where you are stuck, what to practise) are planned for 1.0 and tracked in docs/README.md. Everything runs locally on port 3180 (the regular dsh web on 3080 can run at the same time); requires Node.js 22.5+.
problem: Chat assistants forget everything when a conversation ends, so a new session cannot pick up where the last one stopped.

relations.evidence: DeepSeek Harness (@deepseek-ai/dsh, requires ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2) with a configured DeepSeek model.

summary: Math-notes AI assistant in the right sidebar that keeps layered long-term memory as Markdown in your vault across chat sessions.
